scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 mixed, playable with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable issues; 10 exceptional. Subjective observed portrait emulation quality, not a win/loss grade or certification. Scores cover only content actually reached.

reasons.overall_mobile: Atmospheric and playable with clear objective progression, map help and responsive combat cues, but frequent collision/positioning corrections and difficult fine aiming dominated these two attempts. Better combat in attempt 2 did not remove that friction.
reasons.controls: Two-contact movement plus fire-drag worked and small corrections could hit optics/coils. Dense right-side controls, fine receiver positioning and repeated wall stalls made it demanding at 390px. Reviewer synthetic touch skill is a confounder; no claim that all stalls are input defects.
reasons.gameplay: Receiver recoveries, regenerating shield, dash interruption and armor windows provided observed tactical choices and feedback. Stationary recovery under fire punished tiny positioning errors, and finding clear coil faces was frustrating. Upload, victory and broader balance unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Strong cyan/amber identity, rain, industrial signs and coherent menu styling gave the reached areas atmosphere. Tall flat occluding structures and crowded scene/HUD sometimes impeded target recognition. Audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Concise handbook, persistent named objective, paused route map, numeric reach hints, visible close button and explicit fresh/checkpoint choices were helpful. Frequent need to consult map and correct blocked movement reduced flow. No settings changes.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo, named receivers and phase banners readable in portrait; terminal stats fit. Small compass/secondary text and numbered targets behind cover were harder to scan. Floor ring reach was less clear than numeric distance.

scores.enjoyment_scope: Observed satisfying moments: starting optic clear, warden phase break, receiver confirmation, coil OFF. No inference about unplayed content or continuous enjoyment.
